title: My top 3 Laravel 5.6 features
content:
<html><head></head><body>Yesterday Taylor Otwell released Laravel 5.6 right before the Laracon Online conference. We had a little conference party here in Vienna and a great time watching all the talks together. In one of them, Taylor walked us through the new Laravel features, and I want to point out my top 3 of them.
            </body></html>
author: Christoph Rumpel Blog Feed
